title: Interface to the FWS Unit REST API
text: fwsunitr R interface U.S. Fish Wildlife Service Unit REST API. provides functions retrieve FWS organizational unit information related lookup values public Unit web services. Current functionality (read-) includes: get_regions(): retrieve FWS regions, returned one row per region code name. get_unit(): retrieve unit records. arguments, returns units; otherwise filters name, code, state, region, /type (e.g. type = "refuge"). Direct indirect links omitted default; include links = TRUE. get_geography(): retrieve geography sf object (WGS84). arguments, returns units; otherwise filters name, code, state, region, type. refresh_units(): clear session cache next call fetches fresh data. Responses returned tibbles.

title: Interface to the FWS Unit REST API
text: default API host can overridden session (e.g. target staging environment) via unitsr.base_url option:
code: library(fwsunitr)  # Regions (code and name for each FWS region) get_regions()  # Unit records: all units, or filtered by name, code, state, region, or type get_unit() get_unit(name = "kenai") get_unit(code = "FF07RYKD00") get_unit(state = "AK") get_unit(region = 7) get_unit(type = "refuge") get_unit(region = 7, type = "refuge")  # Geography as an sf object: all units, or filtered by name, code, state, region, or type get_geography() get_geography(name = "kenai") get_geography(code = "FF07RYKD00") get_geography(state = "AK") get_geography(region = 7) get_geography(type = "refuge") options(fwsunitr.base_url = "https://staging-fws-host")

title: Get geography for units by name, code, state, region, or type — get_geography
text: Returns unit geography FWS Unit REST API sf object. arguments, returns geography units. Otherwise keeps units matching supplied name code, narrows also matching state, region, type. Name type matching case-insensitive tolerant partial values; name matching also treats "national wildlife refuge", "nwr", "refuge" equivalent.

title: Get geography for units by name, code, state, region, or type — get_geography
code: get_geography(   name = NULL,   code = NULL,   state = NULL,   region = NULL,   type = NULL,   crs = 4326,   geometry = TRUE )

title: Get geography for units by name, code, state, region, or type — get_geography
text: name Optional character vector full partial unit names (e.g. "kenai", "kenai nwr"). code Optional character vector unit codes (e.g. "FF07RYKD00"). Case-insensitive. state Optional two-letter state code(s) filter (e.g. "AK"). unit matches state codes matches supplied value. Case-insensitive; vectors match . region Optional FWS region(s) filter . Accepts region number (e.g. 7) full region code (e.g. "R0007"); vectors match . type Optional unit type(s) filter , matched type_name field (e.g. "refuge"). Case-insensitive substring match; vectors match . crs Coordinate reference system returned geometries, passed sf::st_sf(). Defaults 4326 (WGS84), CRS API's WKT output. geometry Logical. TRUE (default), return sf object. FALSE, return plain tibble raw WKT geography column.

title: Get geography for units by name, code, state, region, or type — get_geography
text: sf object (tibble geometry = FALSE) columns unit_code, unit_name, geometry (WKT geography column). Units geography yield empty geometries.

title: Get unit information — get_unit
text: Returns unit records tibble. arguments, returns units. Arguments filter set: name matches unit names, code matches unit codes, state matches unit's state code(s), region matches FWS region, type matches unit type (e.g. "refuge"). Units matching supplied name code kept, narrowed also matching state, region, type. Name type matching case-insensitive tolerant partial values; name matching also treats "national wildlife refuge", "nwr", "refuge" equivalent.

title: Get unit information — get_unit
code: get_unit(   name = NULL,   code = NULL,   state = NULL,   region = NULL,   type = NULL,   links = FALSE )

title: Get unit information — get_unit
text: name Optional character vector full partial unit names (e.g. "kenai", "kenai nwr"). code Optional character vector unit codes (e.g. "FF07RYKD00"). Case-insensitive. state Optional two-letter state code(s) filter (e.g. "AK"). unit matches state codes matches supplied value. Case-insensitive; vectors match . region Optional FWS region(s) filter . Accepts region number (e.g. 7) full region code (e.g. "R0007"); vectors match . type Optional unit type(s) filter , matched type_name field (e.g. "refuge"). Case-insensitive substring match; vectors match . links Logical. TRUE, include direct indirect link list-columns (direct_links, direct_inactives, indirect_links, indirect_inactives). Defaults FALSE.

title: Get unit information — get_unit
text: tibble unit fields. links = TRUE, four linkage list-columns appended.

title: Get unit information — get_unit
text: API's /api/Unit/{code} endpoint documented experimental returns placeholder every input, used. Units looked authoritative /api/Unit/unitselector listing, cached session (clear refresh_units()).
